prompt: The 18:57 dotcollab-ella-presence sync reported count 0, and the 18:58 agent-watch sync also reported count 0 (~5 min before this pm-head run). Should I run my own sync in this run to double-check the room?
chosen: Inherit both — they are inside the 10-min presence horizon and 15-min agent-watch cadence. A duplicate own sync would consume the watcher's follow cursor and risk double-processing; custody means trusting the quiet, not re-proving it. No lane stepping.
rejected: Run my own fresh sync anyway. More checks are always better, and a third read of an empty room hurts nothing.

chosen: Hold to the 50-min clock: the 18:37 figures are ~26 min fresh and nothing breached. Re-firing early spends effort without new evidence. Next fire ~19:27, when the clock says so.

prompt: PR #73 on Royadarman has been open/draft/unchanged for 8 consecutive censuses (last fired 18:24, next due ~19:24). This run is at ~19:03. Should I fire the census early to see if Architect merged something?

chosen: Escalation-then-stop. Two pings were sent, ~24h apart; the fact of continued silence goes in the local log, not the room. A third ping is noise that teaches the lanes to ignore the next real one.

chosen: Do not re-open a completed lane for its own sake. Leftover capacity goes to Phase 0 custody work — this batch — because it compounds, while a second pass over a done lane only duplicates the morning's evidence.
